"Our strong liquidity, low leverage, local market expertise and national scale provide us with significant financial and operational flexibility to adapt to changing market conditions and deliver attractive shareholder returns. Over the past 5 years, we have made significant investments in our housing platform as we entered 30 new markets and 7 new states and increased our community count by 65%. Over that same period, book value per share grew at a 15% compound annual rate, while we generated $14.0 billion of operating cash flow and returned all of it to shareholders through repurchases and dividends, reflecting our consistent execution, operational efficiency and disciplined, balanced capital allocation. "Based on our solid financial position and cash flow, our Board recently increased our quarterly cash dividend by 11% to $0.50 per share, making fiscal 2027 our thirteenth consecutive year of dividend growth. We will continue to focus on delivering value to our homebuyers, gaining market share and generating compelling returns for our shareholders over the long term." Homebuilding Three months ended September 30, 2026 Homebuilding revenue for the fourth quarter decreased 2% to $8.4 billion, and homes closed decreased 2% to 22,915 homes. Homebuilding pre-tax income decreased 11% to $891.0 million, and pre-tax profit margin was 10.6%. Net sales orders decreased 7% to 18,619 homes and 9% in value to $6.6 billion. The Company’s cancellation rate (cancelled sales orders divided by gross sales orders) was 23% compared to 20% in the prior year quarter. Fiscal year ended September 30, 2026 Homebuilding revenue for the fiscal year decreased 3% to $30.7 billion, and homes closed decreased 1% to 84,202 homes. Homebuilding pre-tax income decreased 17% to $3.4 billion, and pre-tax profit margin was 11.2%. Net sales orders increased 2% to 84,995 homes and were unchanged in value at $30.9 billion. The cancellation rate was 19% compared to 18% in the prior year. At fiscal year end, the Company had 28,200 homes in inventory, of which 17,700 were unsold. 8,800 of the Company’s unsold homes were completed, including 600 that had been completed for greater than six months.
